headline: MiniMax has released M3.1 Flash, and plans open weights on October 23
body: MiniMax has released M3.1 Flash, a reasoning model that handles up to one million tokens of context and accepts both text and images. API pricing sits at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens. MiniMax plans to release the model as open weights on October 23.
note: At these prices, testing an agent workflow costs little per run, and open weights, if released as planned, would let a bank host the model itself.

evidence.text: MiniMax has released M3.1 Flash, a new reasoning model that scores 42 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index .
The model handles up to one million tokens of context and accepts both text and images.
API pricing sits at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens, with cached inputs at $0.015.
MiniMax plans to release the model as open weights on October 23.
